articles.headline: Daniel Stavchanksy wins Menards 150
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Daniel Stavchanksy won Menards 150 at Kansas Speedway, starting P5 and leading 80 laps. King Robinson finished second and Daniel Dominguez was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 9 cautions.

Caleb Guerrier was the biggest mover, gaining 17 spots from P24 to P7.

Samuel Riggs leads the championship with 3231 points, 63 ahead of John Verstappen.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
